Hi Lukas — thanks, and appreciate you attaching the PO. I work in Billing — happy to confirm routing and VAT. Please see notes below plus a text file with our USD wire instructions attached.

1) EUR / SEPA option
- We can invoice in EUR to an EU EUR account for customers with a valid EU VAT ID and billing address in the EU. If ACME provides the VAT ID (DE123456789 included in your note is good), we will mark the invoice for reverse-charge (VAT = 0) and include the VAT ID on the invoice.
- SEPA transfers are preferred for EUR invoices (lower fees, deterministic routing).

2) USD wire instructions (if you must pay USD)
- Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Bank: First Coast Clearing Bank
- Account: 987654321
- SWIFT: FCCBUS33
- Reference: Invoice 12345 / PO 4501
- Note: Bank-to-bank routing for USD often goes through intermediary correspondent banks (our bank uses IntBank as correspondent). Those correspondents may apply fees.

3) Fees (OUR / SHA / BEN)
- Default: SHA (shared). This is the most interoperable and avoids rejections on some foreign-pay routing.
- If ACME sets OUR, your payer bank will debit your account for the full fees and forward net; however, if an intermediary rejects the OUR instruction for compliance or routing reasons we may receive a short payment and then need to reconcile — that adds latency.
- If you prefer to avoid any surprise, SEPA (EUR) is the recommendation. Alternatively, we can accept card payment for immediate settlement (incurs card fees).

4) Intermediary fee visibility
- We do not control the margin banks apply on FX conversions — if you initiate a USD-to-EUR conversion at your bank, any margin is applied on your side. If we invoice in EUR and you pay via SEPA, there is no USD conversion charge on our side.

5) Next steps to finalize
- If you want an EUR invoice: send formal billing address and VAT ID (company legal name, VAT ID, invoicing address).
- If paying USD via wire and you want OUR: confirm in writing and understand there is a small risk of routing issues/delays.

Attached: RDW_BANK_INSTRUCTIONS_USD_SWIFT.txt (plain text, shows full wire string), invoice_Redwood_12345.pdf (sample invoice we will issue if you confirm currency).

- We do have an EU EUR collecting account via our payments partner (EuroCollect Ltd), so if you confirm VAT ID and billing address we will issue the invoice in EUR and mark it as reverse-charge (VAT 0%).
